en.title: The next model cycle is becoming an infrastructure story
en.summary: Capability gains matter, but deployment cost, power, and distribution increasingly determine who can turn them into products.

zh.title: 下一轮模型竞争正在成为基础设施竞争
zh.summary: 能力提升仍然重要，但部署成本、能源和分发能力正在决定谁能真正把模型转化为产品。

en.title: Open-source agent tooling moves from demos toward operations
en.summary: The fastest-growing projects emphasize observability, permissions, and repeatable workflows rather than another chat interface.

zh.title: 开源智能体工具正从演示走向真实运营
zh.summary: 增长最快的项目开始强调可观察性、权限和可重复工作流，而不再只是增加一个聊天界面。

en.title: Developers are measuring AI by workflow compression
en.summary: Discussion is shifting from benchmark scores toward how many handoffs, tools, and review cycles a system can remove.

zh.title: 开发者开始用工作流压缩程度衡量 AI
zh.summary: 讨论正在从基准分数转向：一个系统究竟能减少多少交接、工具切换和审核周期。

en.title: Efficiency research becomes a product constraint
en.summary: Memory, inference latency, and data quality are moving from optimization details to first-order product decisions.

zh.title: 效率研究正在成为产品设计的核心约束
zh.summary: 内存、推理延迟与数据质量正从优化细节变成一阶产品决策。

en.title: AI policy is moving closer to procurement and deployment
en.summary: The practical question is no longer only what models may do, but which institutions can buy, audit, and operate them.

zh.title: AI 政策正在向采购与部署环节靠近
zh.summary: 现实问题不再只是模型可以做什么，而是哪些机构能够购买、审计并稳定运行它们。

en.title: Interoperability is becoming a competitive advantage
en.summary: Teams increasingly value components that can move between model providers, runtimes, and deployment environments.

zh.title: 互操作性正在成为新的竞争优势
zh.summary: 团队越来越重视能够在不同模型供应商、运行时和部署环境之间迁移的组件。
